name: Ballet of Lights: The Sleeping Beauty
description: A timeless classic gets a luminous twist. This special performance of "The Sleeping Beauty" features shimmering costumes and illuminated choreography, promising a magical and visually stunning evening of dance.
longDescription:
"Ballet of Lights: The Sleeping Beauty" presents a reinterpretation of the classical ballet, incorporating illuminated elements into its costumes and stage design. This production aims to offer a fresh visual perspective on Tchaikovsky's enduring score and Marius Petipa's choreography, blending traditional ballet with contemporary lighting techniques. The event is categorized under art, suggesting a focus on the aesthetic and performative aspects of the production.

Attendees will witness a full-length ballet performance, characterized by its visual effects and classical dance. The duration of the performance is typical for a classical ballet. The atmosphere is intended to be immersive, with the interplay of light and movement central to the audience's experience. The venue for this event varies, indicating that the production may adapt to different theatrical spaces within Porto.

Tickets for "Ballet of Lights: The Sleeping Beauty" are priced variably. Given the nature of the event, advance booking is generally recommended. Specific details regarding venue accessibility and public transport links will depend on the confirmed location closer to the date of the performance on October 24, 2026.
